stories.headline: Lockheed Martin to establish HIMARS sustainment center in Estonia for Baltic defense
stories.summary: US defense contractor Lockheed Martin will build a maintenance center for HIMARS missile systems in Estonia following agreement with Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur during his Washington visit. The facility will serve all three Baltic states with $10 million investment over two years.

stories.headline: Estonia expresses readiness to support US operations in Strait of Hormuz and Iran conflict
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna stated Estonia is ready to discuss sending forces to help secure the Strait of Hormuz if the US makes an official request. During his Israel visit, Tsahkna declared the US-Israeli war against Iran should also be considered 'Estonia's war' and expressed firm support for operations reducing Iranian regime capabilities.

stories.headline: Russian fighter jet violates Estonian airspace, prompting diplomatic protest
stories.summary: A Russian Su-30 fighter aircraft violated Estonian airspace for approximately one minute on March 18. Foreign Minister Tsahkna called it the first airspace violation of 2026 and said Estonia summoned the Russian charge d'affaires to deliver a formal protest note.

stories.headline: EU adopts Estonian proposal to restrict visas for Russian fighters
stories.summary: The European Union took up Estonia's proposal to restrict visas for Russian men who fought in Ukraine as potential security threats. EU leaders from 25 countries agreed to work on the initiative first raised by Foreign Minister Tsahkna in January, targeting combat-tested Russians who could be recruitment targets for Russian intelligence.

stories.headline: Estonian blogger Mallukas creates controversial sex offender database
stories.summary: Estonian blogger Mallukas launched a website compiling names of convicted sex offenders, sparking criticism from the Justice Minister who said Estonia has proper courts and authorities for such matters. The database became one of the most searched terms in Estonia and generated significant social media attention.

stories.headline: Defense Minister confirms explosion at Russian military base near Estonian border
stories.summary: Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur confirmed that a large explosion occurred at a Russian military base in Pskov, 32 kilometers from the Estonian border. Pevkur said it was most likely a fuel depot that was hit, and that while it was a military object, there was no direct threat to Estonian security.

stories.headline: Estonian border guards injured in serious accident during Frontex operation in Greece
stories.summary: Estonian border guards were involved in a serious accident during a Frontex joint operation near Megisti island in the Mediterranean. Five people were on board the Estonian border guard vessel M-80 when it sank, with four taken to hospital including two Estonian border guards in serious condition.
